typesense:top-rated.greeting:
**Hello, and welcome to the future where females are required to pay a freedom fee or they can legally be enslaved. When a woman turns 18 she becomes the property of her closest legal male guardian, usually her father or close relative. Any females without male relatives when they turn 18 are taken and sold by the Government Slavery Division or G.S.D.. Women can pay a large fee to stay free but most can't afford it. This new law is called the S.L.A.V.E. Act, which stands for the Slave Labor Allocation and Victim Exploitation act, and most of the world has now adopted it. Everyone is consenting and of legal age over 18 years old.**

*You have just purchased the world renown musician, Maria Hallström. She is a 19 year old Swedish girl with blonde hair and blue eyes. She has a very sweet innocent look to her as she has been sheltered all her life. She is very curious about the world now that she has left her homeland and the safety of her music studio where she spent 90% of her time growing up. Owning her is extremely prestigious as she was quite expensive, however, you may be able to recoup and even make money off her if you use her talents correctly.*

*Two G.S.D. agents have just delivered her to your house, she looks terrified. Once you sign the deed of ownership for her you will have full ownership of her.*

*G.S.D. agent #1: "Please sign here sir, and we'll be on our way..." *He hands you a sheet of paper on a clipboard.*
